summary: TORM plc filed a 6-K reporting a secondary offering of 6,329,874 Class A shares by OCM Njord Holdings, an Oaktree affiliate, at a price per share stated in the filed underwriting agreement. The company issued no new shares and received no proceeds; the selling shareholder alone sold to J.P. Morgan and other underwriters. The offering was conducted under an effective Form F-3, with delivery on October 7, 2026. The transaction reduces Oaktree's overhang but does not alter TORM's share count, capital structure, or operations.
